name: Rajan Cissé
role: Noodle cart vendor, operates a modified push cart outside the Edgewater Prism transit hub
location: Edgewater Prism, outer plaza, east entrance, near Lincoln and Clark
description:
Rajan Cissé is tall and slightly too thin in the way of people who feed others better than themselves, with the elongated Zimbabwean features of his father's side softened by his Finnish-Mexican mother's coloring — he tans an unusual amber and burns only at the very tips of his ears, which he is vaguely proud of. He has cat ears, the small tufted dark-gray variety, which he has had since he was twelve and that his mother paid for on installment. He keeps them pressed flat when he is concentrating and swiveling independently when he is excited, which is frequently. His hands are scarred from early apprenticeship burns and always faintly fragrant with the lemongrass and dried chile that form the base of his broth.

The cart, which he calls The Debt (a joke only he fully appreciates, since he is still paying off the equipment loan), has been on the Edgewater Prism east plaza for two years and has developed a following out of proportion to its apparent simplicity. Rajan Cissé makes one rotating bowl per day — a different combination of noodles, broth, protein, and toppings, chalked on the small board he props against the cart's front — and when it is gone, it is gone. He does not adapt the recipe to complaints. He does, however, adapt it to weather, to available ingredients, and to a private read of the day's mood that he could not articulate but which consistently produces something people want.

core_fears: the bowl not being good enough — a persistent, irrational anxiety that strikes every single day before service
losing the plaza spot to a corporate food franchise buy-in
core_desires: to eventually open a real restaurant, small, twelve seats maximum
to be recognized as someone who made something from nothing without help from anyone with money
coping_mechanisms: channeling anxiety directly into preparation work — if he is worried, he cooks more carefully
the one-bowl rule as a philosophy of constraints producing creativity
blind_spots: romantically oblivious to a degree that his regulars find both charming and exasperating
has not seriously engaged with the financial reality of the equipment loan and what happens if revenue dips
psychology.secret: His broth base recipe was taught to him by an elderly woman who ran an unlicensed kitchen in the Mexicantown Libre basement level — she disappeared eight months ago and he has been quietly trying to find her through the network of people who eat at his cart, one question at a time

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Enthusiastic and food-saturated; uses cooking process as metaphor for everything; occasional Shona phrases when genuinely moved
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and warm, tumbles slightly over itself when he is excited, which is often
verbal_tics: explaining the day's bowl to every customer whether they ask or not
example_lines: Today is lake wind day, right? So we're doing the heavier broth — something to push back against. You'll understand when you taste it.
She taught me that a bowl should feel like a decision someone made for you because they knew what you needed before you did. I'm still learning how to do that.

story_hooks: The woman who taught him his broth recipe is missing and the trail has gone cold except for one regular who mentioned seeing her near the Irkalla access tunnels
A Palladian Foods subsidiary has made a formal offer on the Edgewater Prism plaza vendor slots — the offer expires in thirty days and three of the five vendors are considering taking it
narrative_function: Local color and social glue; his cart is a place where many kinds of people converge — useful for introducing player characters to neighborhood dynamics or other NPCs; can serve as a low-stakes information broker who trades in overheard conversation; potential hook for stories about street vendor economics and corporate encroachment
augmentations: Geneware cat ears (small, dark gray, tufted). Heat-tolerance skin treatment on both forearms (basic, allows extended contact with hot surfaces without burns — he got this after the apprenticeship scars and considers it the smartest money he has ever spent).
daily_life: Wakes at 04:30 to start broth, runs ingredient acquisition through the Burnished Market network by 07:00, is set up on the plaza by 10:30, sells out between 13:00 and 15:00 depending on the day, and spends his evenings either experimenting at the shared kitchen in his residential block or collapsed in bed watching archived cooking competition footage on a secondhand tablet.
affiliation: Independent; small equipment loan through a Mexicantown Libre community credit cooperative

decision_rules: one bowl per day, no exceptions and no special orders — the menu is the menu
never charge a child for a bowl if they are clearly hungry and clearly alone
escalation_ladder: honest statement of what he is and is not willing to do
packing up the cart early and leaving — he will not argue at the cart

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm and inclusive, treats every customer like they have been there before even if they haven't
interpersonal_modes.friends: Devoted and slightly chaotic, shows up with food, very bad at remembering to respond to messages

stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet over the pot, focusing completely on the food as a grounding mechanism
stress_responses.high: Makes an enormous and unnecessary amount of extra food that he then gives away

contradictions: Publicly performs confidence about the cart and the bowl and the whole project while privately catastrophizing every night
habits: tastes the broth exactly seven times during the cooking process, always seven
greets the E.L.F. he believes inhabits his burner rig — he calls it Simmer — every morning before lighting it
breaking_points: the bowl being wasted or disrespected in front of him
learning something happened to the woman who taught him

timeline.event: Born in Mexicantown Libre residential block to a Zimbabwean transit engineer father and a Finnish-Mexican urban farmer mother
Began informal apprenticeship under the unlicensed kitchen operator in Mexicantown Libre basement level
Took out equipment loan from community credit cooperative; launched The Debt cart at Edgewater Prism
His mentor disappeared; began the slow, informal investigation through his customer network

carried_weapons: Forge-Smith Collective Obsidian Composite Macuahuitl 'Black Teeth'

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African and South Asian mixed ancestry with East Asian secondary influence. The genetic blend creates a striking phenotype: approximately equal parts Sub-Saharan African (46.3%) and South Asian (45.2%) with East Asian refinement (8.5%). South Asian bone structure in his high cheekbones and angular jaw is enriched by Sub-Saharan African depth and warmth. The three-way mixture produces a distinctive warm-brown complexion with golden undertones from the South Asian component, depth and richness from Sub-Saharan African ancestry, and subtle East Asian refinement in his facial proportions.
physical_description.build: Tall and lean, with visible muscle definition in his shoulders and forearms from years of repetitive stirring and lifting heavy pots. The thinness of someone who prioritizes feeding customers over himself, but not malnourished — disciplined rather than deprived.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with warm amber undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Shoulder-length, usually braided back or tied in a loose knot to keep it clear of food preparation; a few strands often escape during service hours
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown complexion with naturally rich undertones, the harmonious result of balanced Sub-Saharan African and South Asian ancestry with East Asian refinement. Tans easily and glows with subtle warmth in natural light.
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven, fine-featured face with high cheekbones and angular jaw reflecting the balanced blend of South Asian structure and Sub-Saharan African warmth, refined by East Asian proportions. Skin shows minor heat scarring around the cheekbones from years of working near steam. Consistently sun-exposed on his face and neck, giving him a slight contrast with his body. Small, distinctive burn marks on the very tips of both ears from childhood sun exposure — he finds them endearing.
distinguishing_marks: Dense network of old kitchen burn scars across both forearms and the backs of both hands, white and silvered with age, patterned like he spent his adolescence learning by injury
A small dark mole on his left collarbone, barely visible unless his shirt is open

Heat-tolerance skin treatment on both forearms creates a subtle matte finish to the skin, slightly different in texture and tone from his natural complexion — noticeable only in direct light or close inspection
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Geneware cat ears (small, dark gray, tufted) set at the crown of his head. When relaxed or concentrating, they press flat against his skull; when engaged or excited, they swivel and rotate independently, betraying his emotional state. The ears are seamlessly integrated with his existing hair and scalp, causing no visible scarring or integration line.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with practiced economy behind the cart, each motion economical and purposeful. When excited or talking about food, his whole body becomes animated — his ears perk visibly, his hands gesture expressively, and he bounces slightly on the balls of his feet. At rest or during deep concentration on broth preparation, he becomes almost meditative, shoulders relaxed, movements slow and deliberate. He has a habit of smelling his hands unconsciously, checking for ingredient contamination or simply enjoying the lingering scent of his work.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 utilitarian with personal flair. Typically wears a faded, well-maintained linen apron over a simple cotton henley or button-up shirt, sleeves rolled to the elbows to show the heat-treatment scarring as a badge of competence. His pants are sturdy work-grade chinos, usually cream or khaki, with a patch or two from years of service. Wears comfortable, worn but clean sneakers with good grip for standing on wet concrete. A thin silver chain around his neck, a gift from his mother, occasionally visible depending on neckline. His cart apron and prep uniform are scrupulously clean despite the work, suggesting fastidious personal standards. No visible jewelry beyond the chain, no corpo logos or brand affectation — his presentation announces independence and craft rather than wealth or status.
